notes.title: Full Version Content
notes.content:
Hello there, fellow gentlemen.

I would like to inform you all that the full version is still in work, but thankfully, not much is left for me to wank into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35023805/ead0d42eb2496b0fb7394d6bbf342a2c64c5b0d4.jpg[/img]
[i]No idea who this guy is, but he exists[/i]

Full version of the game will include following things (and many more, that's not all):
[list]
[*] 6 story missions - each takes 5-30 minutes to complete; and obviously provides new, fun stuff
[*] 2 new game modes - [b]Wank to Live[/b] and [b]Challenges[/b]
[*] New in-game activities & items (weapons etc.)
[*] Global Score Leaderboard
[*] New in-game settings (for example [b]Funny terrain[/b] - makes moveable things react differently, they fly around like crazy, it's fun to look at)
[/list]

Obviously, those are only the things that have come to my mind at the moment, but there will be much more.
What else can I say, stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35023805/abdb72f0442450983a78c6e4321801c6e9e1f286.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Characters Update
notes.content:
Hey, it's me again, [strike]cuming[/strike]  coming in with another, tiny update on the project.

Lots of people have been asking about what kind of characters we will be able to play as - I'll clear it up right now.

So far you can play either as HowToBasic or Ricardo and obviously the one and only, Winston Gay. I couldn't get him to stand still and take a photo, his urge to wank was too big. Who else should I add? Donald Trump? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/baa0231b68967a4345baf23fb8cfeb44eddbeb07.jpg[/img]
[i]HowToBasic and Ricardo having fun together, as seen on the picture[/i]

Each character will have his own special sound effect (HowToBasic screams his head off for example), that we can use to get attention from NPCs.

I have also been adding some fine effects, to improve the wanking experience to the fullest. This is one of 3 abilities - a protective barrier that pushes everything away from our protagonist, thus making it impossible to reach us (the police can succ a dicc):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/65513f75bfa527eeac3edf2bc3ce7e7009d88c4b.jpg[/img]

And yeah, I know Ricardo should have USA shorts, I'll change that once I steal them from Walmart.

notes.title: Weapon Update
notes.content:
Hey, here's the dev!

I wanted to give a quick update on how the game's going - currently I've been adding weapons into the game. Started with a shovel, will add many more, like baseball bats, hammers etc.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/5f1c774049e470e80bbb3533d96e8dc652f549d5.jpg[/img]

To people who asked if the game is like Postal - yes, kinda. 
There will be 5 days and each day our protagonist has different 'things' to get off his checklist.
Wanted to mention special abilities too, like shown below. Use them when you feel like things are getting out of hand (yeah).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35023805/d613c5d427925157f0c976830f4177fa325b9ace.png[/img]

And also if anyone has any ideas of stuff that I could add into the game, then go ahead and post them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1007840/discussions/0/1649918058737030336/]here[/url].

Stay tuned for more :)
